# Chamber load patterns

## Amber shelf clearance
In the Amber chamber, leave at least 23 synthetic millimetres between the highest loaded item and the shelf above it. Check every shelf after loading, including the top shelf. This geometry rule does not specify the foot ring for any body; consult the [body register](../materials/body-register.md).

## Moss shelf clearance
The Moss test chamber uses a different diagram with a 31-unit open margin. Do not transfer Moss values to Amber merely because both diagrams use three uprights.

## Diagram identifiers
Write the chamber name and diagram revision on the load ticket. A colour finish named Amber is not a chamber identifier.
